scope: Actual AudioEngine, shadow lease, raw scratch wrapper and PCM kernel; controlled serial raw ports, live adapter promises and graph/history nodes. No actual WASM/native graph audio, browser scheduling, captured cursor/pitch or vendor quality acceptance.

checks.name: Actual engine transfers five-source history gain ownership raw→live exactly once
Late alignment from old End cannot adopt over a newer Begin on the same shadow
Pending reused Begin plus End then newer Begin cannot revive an older closing owner
Pause during a far rebase retires both owners and stale completion cannot adopt
Prepared silent-pull failure before raw Begin commit cannot become an owned healthy shadow
checks.assertion: Prepared pull error is ignored and dead pull is claimed

checks.name: Natural live source end while raw Begin is pending cannot revive expired live playback
checks.assertion: Expired/disposed live owner is re-claimed after source ended

checks.name: Track/config replacement blocks stale alignment and does not overwrite replacement cursor
Current processor error retires only its deck while late old error cannot touch replacement

provenance: Structured transcription of executed initial8-check tool output after fixture effects-array correction, not byte-for-byte stdout or a fresh rerun. Initial tool output preserved in session.
